scope: Independent proposed prepared receptor only; no docking, candidate generation, model calls, GPU or remote submission
threshold_selection: Exact numerical copy of frozen v1; not changed based on historical pose outcomes. Local protein bounds use full three-residue neighborhoods to bound matrix size; all protein heavy contacts also checked.

altloc.method: Whole-residue lexicographically first label for equal-occupancy alternatives; retain blank records

zero_occupancy.method: Discard unsupported coordinate from rebuild input; reconstruct required atom or residue with PDBFixer, retain old atom record in decisions ledger

missing_sequence.method: Attempt all missing residues from full deposited SEQRES, including artificial five-residue cloning prefix and unresolved termini/12-residue loop; no truncation
missing_sequence.model_accuracy_claim: Unknown until independent geometry checks; even geometric pass does not establish loop accuracy

heterogens.crystal_ligand: Remove AQ4 explicitly from protein receptor; retain original source unchanged
heterogens.water: Remove all crystal waters for declared dry rigid-receptor hypothesis; no solvent/ions added

hydrogens.reactive_residue_variant: A:CYS773 neutral CYS with HG, pre-reaction model
hydrogens.other_variants: OpenMM standard pH-based variants; exact selected variants recorded
hydrogens.termini: Rebuild full deposited termini and use standard ionized termini at pH7; no unrecorded capping

output_provenance.observed_atoms: Retain original coordinates, occupancy and B-factor; record altloc choice
output_provenance.modeled_atoms: Write occupancy0 and B-factor0 with explicit REMARK/model provenance; no claim of experimental occupancy
output_provenance.atom_mapping: Record every output atom identity, source serial or modeling origin, retained/replaced input references and coordinates

failure_policy: Any failed/missing check stops scientific readiness. Preserve proposed coordinates and failure evidence; no automatic threshold changes, residue deletion, structure substitution or second preparation attempt.
limitations: Modeled loop/termini/sidechains are not experimental observations.
Single altloc and pH assumptions do not establish the biologically preferred state.
No full MolProbity/Ramachandran distribution, conformational ensemble or experimental validation.
Prepared v2 artifacts require a new scientific manifest/contract; frozen v1 cannot silently admit them.
